title: Patch: holding down a card with several fusions shows a black screen
thread:
**Issue #3863 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3863: Patch: holding down a card with several fusions shows a black screen
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What happens

On a phone, long-pressing (holding down) a card that has several fusions on it brings up a black screen instead of the card. It was found on mobile; it is not yet known whether desktop's click-and-hold does the same.

## Expected

Holding the card opens whatever a hold normally opens for that card (the full-screen art view, R3345000, or nothing if the card can't open it) and shows the fused card correctly, never a blank or black screen. Releasing or the ✕ closes it as usual.

## Steps to reproduce

1. On a phone (or a phone-sized viewport), start a game.
2. Get a card with more than one fusion on it (a fusion of fusions, e.g. several Equips or Starship fusions onto one unit).
3. Press and hold that card.
4. The screen goes black.

## Where to look (unconfirmed lead)

- The hold is `useFullScreenTrigger` in `apps/web/src/cards/fullscreen.ts`. It calls `openFullScreenArt` with the card's `defId`, and `FullScreenArtHost` / `FullScreenArt` in `apps/web/src/cards/FullScreenArt.tsx` render it as a portal over the whole page.
- A fused card's `defId` is the fusion id (`(a+b+…)`, R179, nested for a fusion of fusions). The full-screen view, `useCardLook` and `fullArtSource` may not resolve that id to art. If so, the full-screen backdrop draws with nothing on it, which would look like a black screen. Also check whether `canOpenFullScreen` should let a fusion through at all: a fusion's rarity or level may come from one ingredient. `apps/web/src/cards/fused.ts` walks a fusion to its ingredients, and `CardArt.tsx` already handles fused art (R3045000).
- Find out whether a single fusion works and only several fusions fail, and whether desktop's click-and-hold shows the same black screen.

## Done when

- Holding a card with several fusions (and a single one) never shows a black screen on a phone or on desktop: it shows the right card art or doesn't open.
- A web unit test covers the hold on a fusion of fusions, and an e2e or component check at phone width if the fix touches layout.
```
